name: Chapter 1: Relations and Functions
description: Types of relations, equivalence relations and classes, one-one and onto functions, composition, inverse, counting functions and relations, with exam-style problems.

name: Chapter 2: Inverse Trigonometric Functions
description: Principal value branches, graphs, standard values, properties and identities, simplification by substitution, composite functions, equations, and exam-style problems.

name: Chapter 3: Matrices
description: Order and types of matrices, equality, addition and scalar multiplication, matrix multiplication, transpose, symmetric and skew-symmetric matrices, invertible matrices, and exam-style problems.

name: Chapter 4: Determinants
description: Determinants of order 2 and 3, area of a triangle, minors and cofactors, adjoint and inverse, solving linear systems, plus determinant properties and exam-style problems.

name: Chapter 5: Continuity and Differentiability
description: Continuity, algebra of continuous functions, differentiability, chain rule, implicit, inverse trig, exponential and logarithmic differentiation, parametric forms, second derivatives, and exam-style problems.

name: Chapter 6: Applications of Derivatives
description: Rate of change and related rates, marginal cost and revenue, increasing and decreasing functions, local and absolute maxima and minima, derivative tests, and optimisation problems with exam-style questions.

name: Chapter 7: Integrals
description: Antiderivatives, substitution, trigonometric identities, standard forms, partial fractions, integration by parts, definite integrals, the fundamental theorems and properties, with every exercise verified.

name: Chapter 8: Application of Integrals
description: Area under a curve with vertical and horizontal strips, areas of the circle and ellipse, curves that cross the axis, and areas between curves with exam-style problems.
